The '''Du Mai system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Bryx sector/Legends|Bryx sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Desert/Legends|desert]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Du Mai]].
